columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when relationship of payment instrument with payer becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when relationship of payment instrument with payer becomes inactive.

columns.name: DEBIT_AUTH_FLAG
columns.description: Whether authorization was obtained from the account holder for debits against the instrument. Only applicable for bank account instruments

columns.name: DEBIT_AUTH_METHOD
columns.description: Method used to obtain debit authorization, with values taken from lookup IBY_EFT_IN_AUTH_METHOD. Only applicable for bank account instruments

columns.name: DEBIT_AUTH_REFERENCE
columns.description: Reference code or number given at the time of debit authorization approval. Only applicable for bank account instruments

columns.name: DEBIT_AUTH_BEGIN
columns.description: Used in upgrade.
